author.aboutMe: ALL MY MODELS ARE FREE. A portfolio of recombinant design. I combine functional parts, natural forms & humor to explore the dignity of machines and tell new stories.

results.name: Modern necklace with crystals
results.description: Modern necklace with 5 pendants adorned with crystals. Paganini's Caprice 24 sheet of music is inscribed on the edge of the pendant.
results.descriptionHtml: Modern necklace with 5 pendants adorned with crystals. Paganini's Caprice 24 sheet of music is inscribed on the edge of the pendant.

dictParameters.imageCaptionInterrogator: there is a necklace with a knot and a chain on it, autodesk 3d rendering, americana vibrant colors, olympics, hoop earrings, inspired by Alesso Baldovinetti, red and blue garments, oc rendered, wearing presidential band, tessellation, hardmesh, hyperrealistoc, featured on 9 9 designs
dictParameters.imageAltTextGen3: "Modern necklace with 5 crystal adorned pendants, inspired by Paganini's Caprice 24, modeled in Blender 3D."
